comments.text:
A couple tips for next playthrough. 👍

* Make deals after 4am, to get both the 20% Curfew bonus and 10% early delivery bonus.
* Cranky Frank is a bum, but he's also the ONLY customer who can order multiple times a day.
* You can block the police station steps with a car to almost eliminate patrols.
* Jessie will be your best customer.
* You can hide in the large waste bins.
* If you kill someone, they do come back to life.
* You'll find a free baseball bat on the basketball court.
* Don't grow multiple strains, just stick to OG Kush until you unlock Granddaddy Perp, then transition to only selling that till you make some good coin and level up.
* Don't bother with delivery app, it's too much money.
* Don't bother with the skateboard, get the van (more storage space)
* Buy a money launder business when you're making money over $5k.
* Don't hire employees till you're making real good money, you gotta pay em like $200 a day.
* Don't buy the barn, save for the warehouse.
* Save the game frequently!

Have fun, mate! 😉

comments.text: 0:08 CoryxKenshin's daily routine begins at 4:31 AM where he grabs four bottles of Saratoga spring water, followed by getting a bowl at 5:37 AM and meticulously preparing ice in his kitchen sink until 7:45 AM. At 7:49 AM, he places the bowl on a white marble table and spends the next few minutes carefully transferring ice between the bowl and sink. Between 8:02 AM and 8:23 AM, he opens the first bottle of Saratoga spring water, takes a sip and spits it out in the sink, then pours the remaining bottles into his prepared ice bowl. From 8:31 AM to 8:53 AM, he tests the water temperature with his hands before putting on a black hat and dunking his head into the ice-cold water twice, which causes him to twitch and run to his couch. Around 10:38 AM, he enters his personal gym for a workout session, attempting to bench press 50 pounds and lifting dumbbells until about noon. After his workout, he tends to his grooming routine, brushing his teeth with an electric toothbrush and admiringly checking his beard in the mirror without actually shaving it. At 1:15 PM, he boots up his PS2 to play Resident Evil 4, fighting zombies until it's time for his afternoon run at 4:14 PM. The evening portion of his day includes recording content in his office, where he discusses past events and controversies, followed by enjoying Hungry Howie's pizza (two pepperoni and one pineapple) that he ordered earlier.
